title: Android Device Pairing Crash
explanation: A NullPointerException occurred during the device pairing process on an Android device, indicating a critical software error in the pairing fragment.
next_step: Investigate the root cause of the crash and update the Android app to handle null objects properly.

title: Unverified device reading data
explanation: A warning log entry indicates an unverified device reading with skew, suggesting potential data integrity issues but not a confirmed security breach or critical error. The evidence is limited to the skew value, which may indicate a data processing anomaly rather than a full security threat.
next_step: Verify device data integrity and ensure proper data validation mechanisms are in place.

title: User Encounter with Billing Error
explanation: A user attempting to upgrade to Pro encounters a billing error message, indicating a UI/UX issue where the payment confirmation process is not properly handled.
next_step: Improve error handling and user feedback for billing upgrades.

title: User Experience Issue with Billing Upgrade
explanation: Users attempting to upgrade to Pro encounter repeated errors, indicating a need for improved UI/UX for billing processes.
next_step: Refactor billing upgrade UI to provide clear feedback and handle errors gracefully.

title: Repeated screen_view events for the same user
explanation: The same user is repeatedly viewing different screens (dashboard, reports, settings, alerts, device_list) with varying latencies. This could indicate a UI issue, such as repeated taps or incomplete flows, though no specific error is observed.
next_step: Investigate repeated screen_view events for user experience issues.
